mobileDemo.title: Mobile app demo
mobileDemo.apiNotice: Interactive sync uses the local Demo. In API mode, the demo app stays separate from server data.

tour.label: Automatic app tour
tour.doneTitle: You have seen the full workflow
tour.doneBody: Driver and control center actions are recorded in the demo. You can keep exploring the app and dashboard.

login.title: Driver sign in
login.body: The app opens with a simulated sign in and no password. The tour signs in as the trip's driver and AvisAI greets them in the bubble.

orb.title: AvisAI, the voice copilot
orb.body: The green orb is AvisAI. It floats over every screen and can be dragged. The tour taps it to talk.

sayStart.title: Conversation: trip start
sayStart.body: The driver says “Got the load, truck ok”. AvisAI listens, confirms the pickup and starts the trip.

reply.title: Agent reply
reply.body: The reply shows in the bubble next to the orb and is spoken on the phone. The trip already shows on the dashboard.

approach.title: Approaching the destination
approach.body: At 8 km, AvisAI notifies the receiver and tells the driver the confirmed dock.

cabin.title: Talking while driving
cabin.body: With the truck moving, the driver talks without touching the screen. The tour opens AvisAI again.

openCabin.title: Full screen
openCabin.body: The full-screen conversation shows the large orb and the last line, readable at a glance.

sayArrive.title: Conversation: arrival
sayArrive.body: He says “I arrived at the receiver”. AvisAI checks in, creates the CCO Task and starts counting the wait.

closeCabin.title: Back home
closeCabin.body: Closing the conversation brings the orb back to float over the app.

queue.title: Unloading queue
queue.body: Here are the expected dock, time stopped, the 5 h free time and accrued detention.

push.title: Escalation to the CCO
push.body: Notices to the CCO move in steps: immediate push, panel and call.

panel.title: Control panel update
panel.body: If the wait continues, the operation records a panel update for the control center to follow.

call.title: Phone contact
call.body: If it remains unresolved, the workflow records a call attempt linked to the trip.

escalation.title: Task escalated
escalation.body: After one hour, the Task is escalated and AvisAI tells the driver by voice.

acknowledge.title: Control center action
acknowledge.body: The tour takes the Task on the dashboard. AvisAI tells the driver the CCO took over.

acknowledgeLocal.title: CCO takes the Task
acknowledgeLocal.body: The tour records that the CCO took over. AvisAI tells the driver in the bubble.

home.title: Trip summary
home.body: On the home screen, the driver sees the route, status and the journey of recorded events.

orbUnload.title: Unloading by voice
orbUnload.body: With unloading done, the driver calls AvisAI again.

sayUnload.title: Conversation: unloading
sayUnload.body: He says “I unloaded”. AvisAI closes the detention, notifies the CCO and the delivery joins the metrics.

auth.title: Every waiting hour tells a story.
auth.subtitle: The RODAR control center turns arrival alerts and conversations into visibility for your operation.
auth.mockNotice: Simulated SSO. Local access, no password or credentials.

traffic.subject: Traffic stopped
traffic.description: Accident ahead. The agent is still collecting the location to suggest a detour.

access.title: Access and profiles
access.subtitle: Hierarchical access flow
access.admin: An administrator registers the user, corporate email, and access role.
access.invite: The invitation is sent to the provided corporate email.
access.password: The user opens the temporary link and sets their own password.
access.twoFactor: Sign-in requires two-factor authentication (2FA) through Keycloak.
access.note: Interface preview. Sending invitations and validating 2FA require identity-service integration.
